title: Building storm sewer pipe.
officialText:
Building storm sewer pipe shall conform to one of the standards listed in Table 1102.4.
TABLE 1102.4
BUILDING STORM SEWER PIPE
MATERIAL STANDARD
Cast-iron pipe ASTM A 74; ASTM A 888;
CISPI 301
Chlorinated polyvinyl chloride ASTM F 437; ASTM F
(CPVC) plasticb 438; ASTM F 439
Concrete pipe ASTM C 14; ASTM C 76;
CAN/CSA A257.1M;
CAN/CSA A257.2M
Ductile-iron pipe AWWA C151
High density polyethylene ASTM D 3350
pipe (HDPE)a
Nonasbestos fiber-cement pipe ASTM C 1450
Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) ASTM D 2665; ASTM D
plastic pipe (Type DWV, 3034; ASTM F 891; CSA
SDR26, SDR35, SDR41, PS50 B182.2; CAN/CSA B182.4;
or PS100)b CSA B 181.2
Vitrified clay pipe ASTM C 400; ASTM C
700
Stainless steel drainage ASME A112.3.1
systems, Type 316L
a. Approved plastic sewer for piping 12 inches and larger in accordance with Section 1101.10, Exception 2.
b. Limited to residential buildings five stories or less in height.
